targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: V3-EXQ-944 (2026-08-22) did not weigh for or against MECH-091: the pre-registered gate is a plain AND over three readiness preconditions and C1/C2/C3, and P3 (rate match between RATE_MATCHED and ALIGNED, max over seeds <= 0.35) failed at 0.914 on seed 42. NOT a falsification and NOT a substrate-absence result -- all four acceptance criteria PASSED and were non-degenerate. CAUSE: the RATE_MATCHED control degenerated into NO_RESET on seed 42 (4 of 236 re-issues executed; its episode_lengths are element-wise identical to NO_RESET for the first 21 of 30 episodes). The collapse is TREATMENT-INDUCED, not a hostile seed: the shared arm-independent warmup on seed 42 sustains a 24.37-step mean and ALIGNED holds 22.53, while RATE_MATCHED falls to 8.50 and NO_RESET to 7.43. The mechanism is a runaway feedback -- withhold the event-aligned reset, episodes shorten, deferred re-issues (delay U{K..2K}, K=10) can no longer fire before the episode ends, so still fewer resets execute. The existing clamp does not arrest it and in fact changes NO outcome: due=min(due,72) while drain() runs before each of range(72) steps, so _global_step never exceeds 71 and a clamped due of 72 can never fire (it would need episode_step_budget-1). Three guards are mis-specified and must be fixed in the successor: (i) P1 floors n_salient_events (measured 89) but the DV is denominated on n_events_with_following_tick, which fell to 10 on NO_RESET/seed42 -- below P1's own floor of 20 -- while P1 reported met=true; (ii) P3 is a ticks/step RATIO and is partially self-cancelling, since RATE_MATCHED depresses numerator and denominator together (seed 100 passed at 8.0% while executing only 50%, 93/186, of its re-issues); (iii) P2 measures a near-constant -- straddle_frac(NO_RESET) is exactly 1.0 in 5 of 5 cells, 0 of 618 events at lag 1, against the driver's declared uniform-over-[1,K] model (p ~ 5e-29), because events are phase-locked to just-after-tick. On the four seeds where the control IS valid (rate deviation 1.8-8.0%) the C3 straddle delta was 0.79-1.00 against a 0.50 floor, which is the TIMING half of what_would_answer; the INTEGRATION half was never measured. Re-run as V3-EXQ-944a. Superseded by that successor; do not weight this run.

(1) VALID for what this run measured: the harm salient-event trigger fires on `harm_signal < 0`, documented at agent.py:9850 (as-ran 751fc5e3) as 'Harm from environment (negative = harm)' -- a value passed into update_residue(), NOT a learned head, so it is unaffected by head grounding and by the EXQ-131 staleness artifact. (2) NOT constructible for an INTEGRATION DV on this protocol: what_would_answer's second half concerns harm/goal ESTIMATES, which are learned heads, and this lineage trains none of them. warmup() runs only compute_prediction_loss() + compute_e2_loss(), and compute_e2_loss trains E2's z_self forward model (predict_next_self, agent.py:11221-11237) -- NOT E2_harm_s. E3's harm_eval/benefit_eval are untrained and therefore random-init; agent.py:9690-9693 states such a signal 'is only meaningful once those heads are grounded (ARC-030 phased protocol) -- a validation using it MUST first assert grounding on a positive control', and this run asserts none. The goal half is not instantiated at all: z_goal_stream.goal_state_present is false with writer_defect null, i.e. configuration rather than defect. So the integration question is complex (probe-gated), not complicated (buildable).

unclaimed_observation.name: survival effect of the event-aligned reset
unclaimed_observation.note: NON-GATING and sign-inconsistent, so it does not move evidence_direction, but it is the run's most interesting unpre-registered signal and no criterion covers it. ALIGNED vs NO_RESET mean episode length: seed 42 22.53 vs 7.43 (3.03x), seed 100 72.00 vs 47.37 (1.52x), seed 7 69.70 vs 68.27 (1.02x), seed 13 69.87 vs 71.23 (0.98x), seed 200 59.87 vs 60.93 (0.98x). Large on 2 of 5, null/reversed on 3 of 5. The driver deliberately de-gated behavioural readouts as noisy and sign-inconsistent on an untrained agent, and this is consistent with that. Worth pre-registering properly on a protocol that grounds the heads.

learning_extracted: A deferred-re-issue rate control can DESTROY the episodes it is measured over. Withholding the event-aligned reset shortens episodes, which prevents deferred re-issues from firing, which withholds more resets -- a runaway feedback that ran to completion on seed 42, where RATE_MATCHED's episode lengths are element-wise identical to NO_RESET for 21 of 30 episodes. The arm did not fail to be constructed; it became the arm it was supposed to be distinguished from.

Episode length under a manipulation is an OUTCOME, not a cell property -- and therefore must never become an eligibility filter. The arm-independent warmup is the measurement that settles it (seed 42: 24.37, vs 8.50/7.43 in the withheld-reset arms). Excluding cells on episode length, or on n_events_with_following_tick, conditions on a post-treatment variable and would discard exactly the cells where the manipulation bites hardest -- biasing the successor toward PASS.

The clamp intended to prevent this is INERT. due = min(due, episode_step_budget) with budget 72, while drain() runs before each of range(72) steps so _global_step tops out at 71: a clamped due of 72 can never fire, and an unclamped due past the budget never fired either. It changes zero outcomes and would need episode_step_budget - 1. Consequence: the budget-overrun losses it was believed to prevent are real and unprevented, and are part of the execution shortfall on the healthy seeds (74/110, 93/186, 270/415).

A readiness guard must be denominated on the quantity the DV is actually computed over. P1's own description says 'the DV is per-event, so a cell below this measured nothing usable', but it floors n_salient_events while straddle_frac is denominated on n_events_with_following_tick -- events with no following tick inside the episode are silently dropped at mech091_phase_reset.py:437-440. NO_RESET/seed42's DV sample was 10 against P1's floor of 20, and P1 reported met=true measured=89.

A RATIO guard whose numerator and denominator are both depressed by the manipulation is partially self-cancelling. P3 compares ticks/step; RATE_MATCHED shortens episodes as well as executing fewer resets, so seed 100 passed at 8.0% deviation while executing 50% of its re-issues. A count-based guard would have surfaced 0.72 there and 0.83/0.89 on seeds 7/200.

A gate can measure a CONSTANT and still be graded met. P2 requires straddle_frac(NO_RESET) >= 0.50 and it is exactly 1.0 in 5 of 5 cells -- 0 of 618 events at lag 1, against the driver's own declared 'uniform-ish over [1,K]' model (p ~ 5e-29), because salient events are phase-locked to just-after-tick. P2 cannot fall below its floor, so it certifies nothing.

With ALIGNED pinned at 0 by a DECLARED implementation identity and NO_RESET pinned at ~1 by that phase-locking, C3 is substantively a manipulation readout rather than an independent consequence of the mechanism. It carries the TIMING half of what_would_answer; the INTEGRATION half ('harm/goal estimates are FULLY INTEGRATED within the following cycle') was never measured, and on this protocol could not be -- see harm_stream_validity.

The pre-registered mapping 'any precondition unmet -> substrate_not_ready_requeue' is too coarse when the preconditions guard heterogeneous things. P1/P2 guard substrate and environment readiness, but P3 guards the harness's own control arm; routing a P3 failure to substrate_not_ready mis-attributes a driver defect to substrate absence. MECH-091's what_would_answer still carries the pre-2026-08-16 SD-006 language ('A run without SD-006 phase 2 self-routes substrate_not_ready') which the GFLAG-0037 SPLIT recorded in the same claim's evidence_quality_note lifted as mis-scoped -- the stale text is the likely source of the coarse mapping.

The biological literature had already specified the shape of control this experiment needs, and it is cited in this claim's own targeted review: Rizzuto 2003 establishes genuine phase reset by showing cross-trial phase locking WITHOUT an increase in oscillatory power, and the Sauseng 2007 entry states that a V3 test of MECH-091 'should include controls that distinguish genuine phase shift from amplitude injection'. RATE_MATCHED is that kind of control -- holding the confound fixed while moving phase -- though the analogy is not exact: Sauseng separates phase from AMPLITUDE, RATE_MATCHED separates phase from RATE. Either way a broken RATE_MATCHED is not a bureaucratic gate trip; it is the loss of the control that makes the result a phase-reset finding at all.

successor_spec.shape: same scientific question, alphabetic suffix -- an implementation/measurement repair, not a new question
must: Do NOT exclude cells on any POST-TREATMENT quantity (episode length, n_events_with_following_tick, execution fraction). Report episode length as an OUTCOME. Post-hoc or pre-registered exclusion on these biases the run toward PASS.
Replace or supplement P3 with a COUNT-based rate guard, n_resets_executed(RATE_MATCHED)/n_resets_executed(ALIGNED) within a declared tolerance. The ratio-of-rates form is self-cancelling.
Re-denominate P1 on n_events_with_following_tick (the quantity straddle_frac actually uses), not n_salient_events.
Replace P2 with a guard that can actually fail, or demote it to a recorded diagnostic. As written it measures a constant.

Address the runaway feedback directly rather than by clamping: the deferral scheme cannot hold rate fixed when the manipulation shortens the episodes the deferral lives in. If a clamp is retained at all it must be episode_step_budget - 1, since the current form is inert.
Split the self-route mapping: P1/P2 unmet -> substrate_not_ready_requeue; P3 unmet -> a control-construction / measurement route, NOT substrate absence.
Record the re-issue execution fraction and the count scheduled past episode end directly, so the diagnosis is legible without recomputation.
must_not: Bolt an INTEGRATION DV onto this run -- see harm_stream_validity: on this P0-only protocol E3's harm_eval is random-init and ungrounded and the goal subsystem is not instantiated, so an integration readout would be vacuous.
